name: Docker::exec_once and warm pool

test_list.description: Reject a container configuration below the minimum memory or CPU ceiling.
Reject secret-like environment names before the Engine API call.
Require explicit argv rather than implicit shell execution.
Choose a named pipe on Windows and Unix socket on Unix.
Require a regular UTF-8 root Dockerfile and reject symlinks and unsafe paths in the tar archive.
Require a stable matching RUN cache mount and a Dockerfile frontend version 1.2 or newer.
Collect literal external COPY --from images for local-only preflight and reject variable references.
Reject undeclared mounts and remote ADD sources before Engine requests.
Reject pool size and aggregate memory budgets outside configured limits.
Only match containers bearing the exact pool, owner, and managed labels.
Opt-in WSL live contract; only the approved immutable image and exact UUID-labelled resources, checking exec output, timeout cleanup, persisted identity recovery, and final daemon absence.

Opt-in WSL BuildKit contract; pinned Docker Hub frontend manifest sha256:b5f3b260a9678e1d83d2fce86eeddf79420b79147eaba2a25986f47133d73720, approved immutable local base only, no build-step network, unique test image tag removed and checked absent.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Validated argv, deadline, environment, and bounded output policy.

output_description: Captured bounded command output and engine-reported exit status, after container cleanup.
